title: Wild AG media frame
description: A media slot that crops an image or video like object-fit cover, with a plain sand placeholder when empty. In 'fixed' mode the footage stays put in the window while its frame scrolls past, so the frame acts as a window onto still footage.
notes: fixed mode clips a position:fixed layer with clip-path; an ancestor with a transform or filter turns it back into an ordinary frame
size, radius and position come from className
name: wild-ag-media

props.name: media
props.description: an or

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder colour: sand (images on paper) or soft (a pale light-to-sand wash for big footage)

props.name: fixed
props.description: true: the footage is fixed to the window and the frame only shows the part behind it

props.name: roundBottom
props.description: round the bottom corners with the bands' big radius (fixed frames can't use a rounded class)

props.name: className
props.description: sizing, radius and position of the frame
